hook.en: Is a weed just a flower that nobody asked for? Mr Lamb thinks the way we look at things changes them.

objectives.en: Explain Mr Lamb's philosophy of life
Interpret the story of the man afraid to go out
Show how these ideas affect Derry

narration.en: Is a weed just a flower that nobody asked for? Mr Lamb thinks the way we look at things changes them.

body.en: Mr Lamb believes that how we see things matters more than how they look. To him, weeds and flowers are both living things; the difference lies only in what people want. He keeps his gate open, enjoys small pleasures like the hum of bees, and refuses to hide from life because of his leg.

points.en: Weeds and flowers: just a label
Keep the gate open to life

say.en: At the centre is Mr Lamb and his way of seeing.
Weeds and flowers differ only in our labels.
His open gate shows he welcomes everyone.
He finds joy in bees, apples and sounds.
Hiding from life will not keep you safe.
Look at the world, not at your face.

passage.en: Mr Lamb believes that how we __1__ things matters more than how they look. To him, weeds and __2__ are both living things. He keeps his garden __3__ open to everyone. He tells of a man who stayed __4__ out of fear and was still killed when a picture fell on him. The lesson is that hiding does not keep us __5__.

explanation.en: Mr Lamb refuses to let his tin leg shut him away from life, and he teaches Derry the same.

body.en: Mr Lamb tells Derry about a man who was so afraid of the world that he stayed indoors, and yet was killed when a picture fell on him. The message is that hiding does not make us safe; we should live fully. He also tells Derry that people's reactions are their problem, and that if Derry thinks about the world, not his face, the world will matter more.

points.en: Hiding does not keep us safe
Look outward, not at your face

problem.en: What is the point of Mr Lamb's story about the man who stayed indoors?

steps.en: The man hid from the world out of fear.
Yet he was killed indoors by a falling picture.
So hiding does not guarantee safety.
Derry should not shut himself away because of his face.

answer.en: Mr Lamb describes a man who feared the outside world and stayed at home, only to be killed when a picture fell on him. The point is that shutting oneself away does not bring safety, and it wastes life. Mr Lamb wants Derry to stop hiding because of his face and to live fully among people.
